name: ai.ekwo/mcp
title: Ekwo OS
description: Open source accounting data infrastructure on your own Postgres, acting as the user under RLS.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The anon (publishable) key. Never the service_role key: the server refuses it.

environmentVariables.name: EKWO_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The user the assistant acts as

environmentVariables.name: EKWO_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An access token, instead of email and password

environmentVariables.name: EKWO_DB_URL
environmentVariables.description: Direct Postgres connection, for a self-hosted database without PostgREST

environmentVariables.name: EKWO_ACT_AS_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Required with EKWO_DB_URL: the auth.users id the server acts for
